# What this notebook does

Kate, 2026-10-30: first step towards picking reporter mRNAs for eIF3d-dependent translation in
hypoxia. The three features judged important for that regulation are 5'UTR length, CDS length
and GC3 (`gc3_internal`: third codon positions, initiator and stop removed). This notebook places
every mRNA on all three on one shared z-score axis.

- **Which genes:** every gene in the hypoxia 1hr eIF3d model (`r params$suffix`) that has a value
  for all three features. No other filter.
- **The z-score is the heatmap's z-score**, not a new one: the per-gene values of
  `40_target_clusters_gc3_length.Rmd` (the three-feature cluster notebook), z = (gene - mean) / sd
  over the same genes, uncapped. They are **imported** from `r params$zscore_csv` and
  **recomputed here independently** from the feature matrix; the notebook stops if the two differ.
- **Orientation:** CDS length and GC3 are **negated** (-z), so higher = more eIF3d-favorable in
  every column: long 5'UTR, short CDS, AU-rich third positions. The direction is not assumed - it
  is asserted against the observed TE change in section 3.
- **Not a combined score.** No weighting or summing yet; candidate selection comes after the plots.

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(here) })
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
SAVE <- isTRUE(params$save_plots)
TOL <- 1e-12
feat_lab <- c(utr5 = "log2 5'UTR length (z)", cds = "CDS length (-z)", gc3 = "GC3 (-z)")
grp_cols <- c("All genes" = "grey70", "Negative controls" = "black", "eIF3d hypoxia targets" = "#E69F00")
```

# 1. Inputs and checks

```{r load}
de <- read_csv(here("output", params$de_file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("[.].*", "", gene_id))
stopifnot("DE table has duplicate genes" = !anyDuplicated(de$gene_id_clean))
kd <- de$rna_lfc[de$symbol %in% "EIF3D"]
stopifnot("EIF3D not found once" = length(kd) == 1,
          "EIF3D rna_lfc not > 1: wrong file or flipped direction" = kd > 1)
cat(sprintf("%s: EIF3D rna_lfc %+.2f -> columns are log2(sictrl / si3d), positive = eIF3d promotes\n", params$de_file, kd))

oof <- readRDS(file.path(O, paste0("shap_oof_", params$suffix, ".rds")))
mg <- oof$genes
stopifnot("model genes duplicated" = !anyDuplicated(mg$gene_id_clean),
          "model TE differs from the DE file" =
            max(abs(mg$y - de$te_lfc[match(mg$gene_id_clean, de$gene_id_clean)])) < TOL,
          "unexpected model sets" = setequal(unique(mg$set), c("eIF3d promoted", "negative control", "other")))

fm <- readRDS(file.path(O, params$matrix_rds))
stopifnot("matrix has duplicate genes" = !anyDuplicated(fm$gene_id_clean),
          "model genes missing from the matrix" = all(mg$gene_id_clean %in% fm$gene_id_clean),
          "feature columns missing" = all(c("gc3_internal", "log2_cds_length", "log2_utr5_length",
                                            "cds_length", "utr5_length") %in% names(fm)))
num <- function(col) as.numeric(unlist(fm[[col]][match(mg$gene_id_clean, fm$gene_id_clean)]))
raw <- mg %>% transmute(gene_id_clean, symbol, te_lfc = y, te_padj = y_padj, set,
                        gc3 = num("gc3_internal"), cds = num("log2_cds_length"), utr5 = num("log2_utr5_length"),
                        cds_nt = num("cds_length"), utr5_nt = num("utr5_length"))
stopifnot("log2 5'UTR length is not log2(nt + 1)" = max(abs(raw$utr5 - log2(raw$utr5_nt + 1))) < TOL,
          "log2 CDS length is not log2(nt + 1)" = max(abs(raw$cds - log2(raw$cds_nt + 1))) < TOL,
          "lengths missing" = !anyNA(raw$cds) && !anyNA(raw$utr5))
# The only missing feature is GC3, and only where the CDS is not a complete reading frame
stopifnot("a gene lacks GC3 but has an in-frame CDS that is not flagged" =
            all(is.na(raw$gc3) | raw$cds_nt %% 3 == 0))
a <- raw %>% filter(!is.na(gc3))
stopifnot("GC3 outside [0, 100]" = all(a$gc3 >= 0 & a$gc3 <= 100),
          "GC3 median outside 40-65%" = between(median(a$gc3), 40, 65),
          "lengths out of range" = all(a$cds_nt > 0) && all(a$utr5_nt >= 1),
          "a kept gene has an out-of-frame CDS" = all(a$cds_nt %% 3 == 0))
cat(sprintf("model genes %s; with all three features %s (dropped %d without GC3)\n",
            scales::comma(nrow(raw)), scales::comma(nrow(a)), nrow(raw) - nrow(a)))
```

## Gene groups

```{r groups}
gs <- sub("[.].*", "", read_csv(here("output", "genesets", params$geneset_csv), show_col_types = FALSE)$ensembl_gene)
a <- a %>% mutate(target = set == "eIF3d promoted", negctrl = set == "negative control")
stopifnot("targets differ from the saved gene-set CSV" = setequal(a$gene_id_clean[a$target], intersect(gs, a$gene_id_clean)),
          "targets not TE LFC > 0.5, padj < 0.05" = all(a$te_lfc[a$target] > 0.5 & a$te_padj[a$target] < 0.05),
          "negative controls not |TE LFC| < 0.5, padj > 0.3" =
            all(abs(a$te_lfc[a$negctrl]) < 0.5 & a$te_padj[a$negctrl] > 0.3),
          "a gene is both target and negative control" = !any(a$target & a$negctrl))
cat(sprintf("eIF3d hypoxia targets %s; negative controls %s (|TE LFC| range %.2f, min padj %.2f); other %s\n",
            scales::comma(sum(a$target)), scales::comma(sum(a$negctrl)), max(abs(a$te_lfc[a$negctrl])),
            min(a$te_padj[a$negctrl]), scales::comma(sum(!a$target & !a$negctrl))))
```

# 2. Z-scores: imported and recomputed

```{r zscores}
zi <- read_csv(file.path(O, params$zscore_csv), show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot("imported z table has duplicate genes" = !anyDuplicated(zi$gene_id_clean),
          "imported z table covers different genes" = setequal(zi$gene_id_clean, a$gene_id_clean))
zi <- zi[match(a$gene_id_clean, zi$gene_id_clean), ]
stopifnot("imported raw values differ from the matrix" =
            max(abs(zi$gc3 - a$gc3), abs(zi$cds - a$cds), abs(zi$utr5 - a$utr5)) < TOL,
          "imported target labels differ" = identical(zi$target, a$target),
          "imported TE differs" = max(abs(zi$te_lfc - a$te_lfc)) < TOL)

# Independent recomputation, written out longhand rather than with scale()
zr <- function(x) (x - sum(x) / length(x)) / sqrt(sum((x - mean(x))^2) / (length(x) - 1))
a <- a %>% mutate(z_gc3 = zr(gc3), z_cds = zr(cds), z_utr5 = zr(utr5))
dev <- c(gc3 = max(abs(a$z_gc3 - zi$z_gc3)), cds = max(abs(a$z_cds - zi$z_cds)), utr5 = max(abs(a$z_utr5 - zi$z_utr5)))
print(signif(dev, 3))
stopifnot("recomputed z differs from the imported heatmap z" = all(dev < TOL))
zs <- a[, c("z_gc3", "z_cds", "z_utr5")]
stopifnot("z not mean 0" = all(abs(colMeans(zs)) < 1e-9), "z not sd 1" = all(abs(sapply(zs, sd) - 1) < 1e-9))

# Hand check on named genes: z from the gene's raw value and the background mean / sd
for (s in c("ACTB", "GAPDH", "TSPAN6")) {
  i <- which(a$symbol == s); stopifnot("hand-check gene not found once" = length(i) == 1)
  stopifnot("hand-computed z wrong" = abs((a$gc3[i] - mean(a$gc3)) / sd(a$gc3) - zi$z_gc3[i]) < TOL,
            "hand-computed z wrong" = abs((a$cds[i] - mean(a$cds)) / sd(a$cds) - zi$z_cds[i]) < TOL)
}
# Extremes land at the ends
stopifnot("shortest CDS does not have the lowest CDS z" = a$z_cds[which.min(a$cds_nt)] == min(a$z_cds),
          "longest 5'UTR does not have the highest 5'UTR z" = a$z_utr5[which.max(a$utr5_nt)] == max(a$z_utr5),
          "highest GC3 does not have the highest GC3 z" = a$z_gc3[which.max(a$gc3)] == max(a$z_gc3))

# Orient: higher = more eIF3d-favorable (short CDS, AU-rich GC3)
a <- a %>% mutate(o_utr5 = z_utr5, o_cds = -z_cds, o_gc3 = -z_gc3)
cat(sprintf("z vs %s genes; max |deviation| imported vs recomputed %.1e\n", scales::comma(nrow(a)), max(dev)))
```

# 3. Do the oriented z-scores agree with eIF3d-dependent TE change in hypoxia?

Every oriented column should rise with TE change (sictrl vs si3d), sit above zero for the
targets, and hold more targets in its most favorable tenth than in its least favorable tenth.

```{r spot_checks}
oc <- c(utr5 = "o_utr5", cds = "o_cds", gc3 = "o_gc3")
chk <- imap_dfr(oc, function(v, f) {
  dec <- ntile(a[[v]], 10)
  tibble(feature = f,
         spearman_vs_te = cor(a[[v]], a$te_lfc, method = "spearman"),
         mean_z_targets = mean(a[[v]][a$target]), mean_z_other = mean(a[[v]][!a$target]),
         wilcox_p = wilcox.test(a[[v]][a$target], a[[v]][!a$target])$p.value,
         target_rate_least = mean(a$target[dec == 1]), target_rate_most = mean(a$target[dec == 10]))
})
knitr::kable(chk, digits = c(0, 3, 3, 3, 1, 3, 3), caption = sprintf("oriented z vs TE change, n = %s genes", scales::comma(nrow(a))))
stopifnot("an oriented z does not rise with TE change" = all(chk$spearman_vs_te > 0),
          "targets are not on the favorable side" = all(chk$mean_z_targets > 0 & chk$mean_z_targets > chk$mean_z_other),
          "targets vs other not significant" = all(chk$wilcox_p < 0.05),
          "most favorable tenth does not hold more targets" = all(chk$target_rate_most > chk$target_rate_least))

# Known biology. Ribosomal-protein mRNAs (TOP mRNAs): very short CDS and very short 5'UTR
rp <- a %>% filter(str_detect(symbol, "^RP[LS][0-9]+[A-Z]?[0-9]*$"))
cat(sprintf("ribosomal proteins n = %d: median oriented z  5'UTR %+.2f  CDS %+.2f  GC3 %+.2f; median TE change %+.2f\n",
            nrow(rp), median(rp$o_utr5), median(rp$o_cds), median(rp$o_gc3), median(rp$te_lfc)))
stopifnot("too few ribosomal proteins matched" = nrow(rp) > 50,
          "ribosomal proteins do not score favorable on CDS (short)" = median(rp$o_cds) > 0,
          "ribosomal proteins do not score unfavorable on 5'UTR (short)" = median(rp$o_utr5) < 0)
# ACTB: GC-rich third positions and essentially no TE change
actb <- a %>% filter(symbol == "ACTB")
cat(sprintf("ACTB: GC3 %.1f%% (oriented z %+.2f), TE change %+.2f\n", actb$gc3, actb$o_gc3, actb$te_lfc))
stopifnot("ACTB GC3 not GC-rich" = actb$o_gc3 < 0, "ACTB has a large TE change" = abs(actb$te_lfc) < 0.5)
```

**Ribosomal-protein mRNAs are strong eIF3d targets that the 5'UTR column scores as unfavorable**,
because their 5'UTRs are very short. The features do not capture TOP mRNAs.

## The 5'UTR effect is a floor, not a trend

The z-score rewards every extra nucleotide equally. The target rate does not: it is depressed for
very short 5'UTRs and roughly flat above ~50 nt.

```{r utr5_shape}
utab <- a %>% mutate(`5'UTR length (nt)` = cut(utr5_nt, c(0, 25, 50, 100, 200, 400, Inf),
                                                labels = c("<=25", "26-50", "51-100", "101-200", "201-400", ">400"))) %>%
  group_by(`5'UTR length (nt)`) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), target_rate = mean(target), median_te_change = median(te_lfc), .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(utab, digits = c(0, 0, 3, 3))
stopifnot("every 5'UTR bin populated" = nrow(utab) == 6 && all(utab$n > 100))
```

# 4. The plot

EIF3D is left off the figure: the siRNA depletes its own mRNA, so its TE change is not eIF3d
biology. It stays in the background used for the z-scores, which are the heatmap's.

```{r plot_data}
pd_all <- a %>% filter(symbol != "EIF3D") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(o_utr5, o_cds, o_gc3), names_to = "feature", values_to = "z") %>%
  mutate(feature = factor(feat_lab[sub("o_", "", feature)], levels = feat_lab))
n_bg <- n_distinct(pd_all$gene_id_clean); n_t <- sum(a$target & a$symbol != "EIF3D"); n_n <- sum(a$negctrl & a$symbol != "EIF3D")
stopifnot("EIF3D not removed exactly once" = n_bg == nrow(a) - 1,
          "every column must hold one dot per gene" = all(table(pd_all$feature) == n_bg),
          "plotted z differs from oriented z" =
            max(abs(pd_all$z[pd_all$feature == feat_lab["cds"]] + a$z_cds[a$symbol != "EIF3D"])) < TOL)
sub_txt <- function(groups) paste0(
  sprintf("z-score vs all %s genes with all three features; CDS length and GC3 negated (-z) so higher = more eIF3d-favorable in every column\n",
          scales::comma(nrow(a))),
  paste(c(sprintf("grey = all genes, n = %s", scales::comma(n_bg)),
          if ("n" %in% groups) sprintf("black = negative controls, n = %s", scales::comma(n_n)),
          if ("t" %in% groups) sprintf("orange = eIF3d hypoxia targets (TE LFC sictrl vs si3d > 0.5, padj < 0.05), n = %s", scales::comma(n_t))),
        collapse = "; "))
```

## Version 1: eIF3d hypoxia targets

```{r plot_v1, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6.5}
set.seed(9)
p1 <- ggplot(pd_all, aes(feature, z)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_jitter(color = grp_cols[["All genes"]], width = 0.3, height = 0, size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(data = filter(pd_all, target), color = grp_cols[["eIF3d hypoxia targets"]],
              width = 0.3, height = 0, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "z-score (higher = more eIF3d-favorable)",
       title = sprintf("%s: 5'UTR length, CDS length and GC3 of every mRNA", params$label),
       subtitle = sub_txt("t")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8))
p1
if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", "43_reporter_feature_zscores_targets.pdf"), p1, width = 9, height = 6.5)
```

## Version 2: eIF3d hypoxia targets and negative controls

Within each feature the three groups are drawn side by side (all genes, negative controls,
eIF3d targets last) so that the black dots do not hide the orange ones.

```{r plot_v2, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 6.5}
pd2 <- bind_rows(pd_all %>% mutate(group = "All genes"),
                 pd_all %>% filter(negctrl) %>% mutate(group = "Negative controls"),
                 pd_all %>% filter(target) %>% mutate(group = "eIF3d hypoxia targets")) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = names(grp_cols)))
grp_n <- c("All genes" = n_bg, "Negative controls" = n_n, "eIF3d hypoxia targets" = n_t)
stopifnot("group counts wrong" = all(table(pd2$group)[names(grp_n)] == grp_n * 3))
grp_lab <- sprintf("%s (n = %s)", names(grp_n), scales::comma(grp_n))
set.seed(9)
p2 <- ggplot(pd2, aes(feature, z, color = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.25, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.85),
             size = 0.4, alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = grp_cols, name = NULL, labels = grp_lab) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha = 1))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "z-score (higher = more eIF3d-favorable)",
       title = sprintf("%s: 5'UTR length, CDS length and GC3 of every mRNA", params$label),
       subtitle = sub_txt(c("t", "n"))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8), legend.position = "bottom")
p2
if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", "43_reporter_feature_zscores_targets_negctrl.pdf"), p2, width = 11, height = 6.5)
```

## Version 2 as violins

The same groups and order; the line in each violin is the group median.

```{r plot_v2_violin, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 6.5}
p2v <- ggplot(pd2, aes(feature, z, fill = group, color = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_violin(position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), width = 0.8, alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.5,
              draw_quantiles = 0.5, scale = "width") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = grp_cols, name = NULL, labels = grp_lab) +
  scale_color_manual(values = grp_cols, name = NULL, labels = grp_lab) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "z-score (higher = more eIF3d-favorable)",
       title = sprintf("%s: 5'UTR length, CDS length and GC3 of every mRNA", params$label),
       subtitle = paste0(sub_txt(c("t", "n")), "\nviolins scaled to equal width; line = median")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8), legend.position = "bottom")
p2v
if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", "43_reporter_feature_zscores_targets_negctrl_violin.pdf"), p2v, width = 11, height = 6.5)
```
